RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","On first scan, latch on the Do_Once bit","OTL(Do_Once)","0"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Initialisation rung: called on first scan or if is_setup is not true$NThe init bit is used to detect whether initialisation has been complgted by the following rung$N$Ninitialise sequence by setting Step =1$NDefine strings used for constructing path to active supervisor$NSet timer preset to 0.5 second - this is the interval for polling individual objects$NFinal step defines the number of steps in the AOI. To add steps, increase this value$NSet path defined in configuration as the default path so that AOI has recovery mechanism","MOV(5000000,Msg_Get_Sgl.UnconnectedTimeout)","1"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Rung to analyse default path and strip the IP address$NThis is used to construct the path to the active supervisor later in the program","OTU(Do_Once)","2"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Lock State machine if AOI is not enabled","CLR(Step)","3"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Free-running step timer","TON(Timer,?,?)","4"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Step 1 - Poll a node for a supervisor address$NIf IP address of supervisor is 0 then go to error step","MOV(110,Step)","5"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Step 3$NConstruct path out to the ethernet network and propogate to all message instructions used in code$N","MOV(4,Step)","6"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Step 4$NRead Supervisor Information abot DLR$NIf IP address of supervisor is 0 then go to error step","MOV(110,Step)","7"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Step 6$N$NRead ring participants list from active supervisor$N(Class 71, Instance 1, Attribute 9)$NCopy result array and convert to user-readable strings","MOV(7,Step)","10"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","New Step 7$NVerify that network had no fault then we got a participant list.","MOV(9,Step)","11"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Update Participants list$NFor Node 0 we will be using supervisor addresses","MOV(10,Step)","12"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Fill the empry nodes with Zeros","RES(Timer)","13"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Prepare to scan individual nodes","MOV(13,Step)","14"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Verify if DLR node has IP address - IP address for some devices is optional","MOV(17,Step)","15"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Read Device identity","RES(Timer)","16"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Repeat for other nodes","MOV(20,Step)","17"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Starting polling all nodes for DLR information","MOV(22,Step)","18"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Poll a node if IP address is not 0","MOV(27,Step)","19"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Poll DLR object","RES(Timer)","20"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Repeat for other nodes","MOV(20,Step)","21"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Takeover order soring","MOV(Final_Step,Step)","22"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Intermediate step to slow down messaging","ADD(Step,1,Step)","30"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Final step$NIntroduce a delay before re-starting sequencer: return to initial step if sequence is complete and timer is done","MOV(1,Step)","34"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Get All Message$NTriggered by Message_Triggers$NIf Done, unset message triggers bit to allow step to continue with copy$NIf an error is detected, on first error, reset the sequencer$NIf the error still exists then go to error step","OTU(Message_Triggers.20)","35"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Get Single Message$NTriggered by Message_Triggers bits$NIf Done, unset message triggers bit to allow step to continue with copy$NIf an error is detected, on the first error restart the sequencer$NIf the error still exists then go to error step","OTU(Message_Triggers.2)","36"

RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Step 100 and 101$NBoth triggered by messaging errors$NIndicate to HMI by setting correct bit$NOn operator input, clear error, reset path to default and restart sequencer","OTL(Do_Once)","41"
RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","Step 110$NToo many nodes","MOV(1,Step)","42"

RCOMMENT,"DLR_AOI:AOI","Logic","The following rung provide automated way to rebuild participants list after ring recovered from the break $N$NState 0 - wait until ring is $QNormal$Q","MOV(1,RebuildState)","49"
